title: Escalating Hardcore Mode
description: This is a datapack that drastically increases the difficulty of your game.
body:
![------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b84b9d0debd223afff1172306c2665062a5b3c2b.png)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
☠️ This is a datapack that drastically increases the difficulty of your game.
In this datapack, both your environment and the monsters around you become increasingly challenging.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

📁 No resource pack is required.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑This datapack is recommended for a minimum of 2 players.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

👹 Upon entering your world, you'll be able to choose from five pacts, each granting unique advantages in exchange for permanent hearts.

❤️ You can regain hearts by defeating custom bosses, which appear every five days.

🧌 Additionally, monster difficulty increases over time — they gain better armor and stronger weapons.

⚔️ This datapack contains 18 mini-bosses and 1 final boss, all fully custom.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
